notes: #3 is dated only “18th century” by the BnF; its companion piece (#1) shows the arrival of Marshal Richelieu, which fits his March 1756 departure for Minorca from Toulon (he was made marshal in 1748), so “about 1756”; drop it if that inference is too loose. #10 is marked event because it shows the scuttled fleet; Commons date field says September but the description gives 29 August 1944. #15 (2017, sharper but partial view toward the naval base) is a fallback for P6.
